Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that fish first appeared ~240–250 million years ago, which contradicts established evidence that fish originated much earlier (Cambrian/Ordovician, ~530–480 million years ago). This factual error could mis-rank groups (making reptiles seem older than fish) and directly lead to an incorrect conclusion if used for comparison.
